name: Ectoplasmic Grasp
description: A massive ectoplasmic hand forms around a creature and squeezes it.
disable: DC 24 Occultism check (trained) to send the ectoplasm back to the Ethereal Plane or DC 26 Acrobatics check to move through and disrupt the coalescing ectoplasm before it takes hold

offensiveAbilities.name: Squeeze
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves over the haunt's area

Effect The hand forms out of ectoplasm and squeezes the triggering creature, dealing 3d8+14 bludgeoning damage (DC 22 basic Fortitude save). On a failure, the creature is Immobilized (Escape DC 22).
